Vishv prasiddh harihar kshetr sonpur mela-2026 ka bhavy aagaj ho gaya hai. bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne sham 7 baje nakhas kshetr sthit paryatan vibhag ke mukhy sanskritik karyakram sthal par mele ka vidhivat udghatan kiya. karib 21 varshon bad aisa mauka aaya hai, jab bihar ke mukhyamantri ne khud is aitihasik mele ka udghatan kiya hai.
